notes.title: Minor Update #2
notes.content:
This patch focuses on improving login stability, UI consistency, and overall responsiveness:

✅ Improved login reliability – Addressed rare cases where multiple login attempts could trigger unexpectedly
⚡ Faster data synchronization – Heroes, cards, and store content now load in parallel to reduce waiting time
📊 Fixed post-battle stats refresh – Player profile stats now update correctly after each match
🧠 Smarter loading feedback – Clearer messages during each stage of login and synchronization
🔌 Better connection handling – Improved support for unstable or lost internet connections during login

Thanks for playing! We’re committed to delivering a smoother and more stable experience with every patch.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
This patch focuses on improving game stability and reliability in several key areas:

✅ Fixed post-battle flow issues – Resolved a problem where, after finishing a battlefield, players could encounter issues returning to the main menu or continuing gameplay
🎁 Improved reward handling – In-game rewards and store purchases are now processed more reliably
🔔 Safer notification parsing – Added stronger safeguards against unexpected or invalid data in backend messages
🛠️ Better debug visibility – Internal improvements to error reporting for faster issue tracking
🔄 Minor backend cleanups and optimizations

Thanks for your support! We're continuing to improve stability and your gameplay experience.
